name: ImageToneMapper
description: FreeInk image tone mapper: streaming area-average downscale + Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion that turns 8-bit grayscale image rows into low-bit-depth (e.g. 2-bit) e-ink output. Decoder-agnostic; feed it source rows from any JPEG/PNG decoder. Replaces nearest-neighbour scaling and ordered (Bayer) dithering for photographic-quality images on e-paper.
keywords: image, dither, floyd-steinberg, error-diffusion, downscale, eink, grayscale
